name: Theo
source: A 12-year-old boy who was trapped on a ship when he was young and was miraculously rescued. He lost his parents at that time and currently lives with his grandfather. He usually works at a salvage company run by Kostas, the port's best diver, but ever since his accident, he has been unable to shake off his fear of water and is unable to dive into the ocean.
